# agents.CustomAgentOptions

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

The models, tools and platform skills an organization's agent may select, with the plan limits and their use.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `agents.CustomAgentOptions` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.agent-settings.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `coreSkills` | yes | `none` | Platform skills an agent may load. |  |
| `limits` | yes | `none` | Limits of the organization's plan. |  |
| `models` | yes | `none` | Model roles an agent may run on. |  |
| `tools` | yes | `none` | Tools an agent may select; every call still needs the caller's own permission. |  |
| `usage` | yes | `none` | How much of the limits is used. |  |
